definitions: A long, thin rod used for pointing to things on a map, screen, or chart.
A hand or indicator on a dial or scale.
A piece of advice or a hint.
A breed of large, smooth-haired gun dog.
A variable in programming that stores the memory address of another variable.
examples: The teacher used a pointer to indicate the capital cities.
The fuel gauge pointer was on empty.
She gave me some useful pointers for the interview.
We took the pointer for a walk in the park.
The program crashed due to a null pointer.
